Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency is less likely given age/onset and smoking history favoring smoking-related emphysema. Overall, the most likely diagnosis is smoking-related COPD with predominance of emphysema.

DIAGNOSIS: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease — emphysema-predominant (smoking-related).
